source.title: How the U.S. Doomsday Plane Works

chapters.title: The Polarization Hook & Secret Counterpart
chapters.editing_formula: Show iconic known subject (Air Force One VC-25) -> contrast with secret apocalyptic machine (E-4B Doomsday Plane) -> whoosh into 3D digital interior reconstruction.

chapters.title: The System Problem & Nuclear Triad Chain of Command
chapters.editing_formula: Protocol breakdown at Offutt AFB -> 3-way branch (Land, Sea, Air Triad) -> System vulnerability question (EMP blast & communication blackout).

chapters.title: Operation Looking Glass (24/7 29-Year Airborne Alert)
chapters.editing_formula: Historical timeline -> 24/7 continuous flight radar loop -> Transition from EC-135 to Boeing 747-200 (E-4B).

chapters.title: 3D Digital Interior Cross-Section (Room-by-Room Walkthrough)
chapters.editing_formula: Compartment zoom-in -> highlight active room in Neon Amber (#FF5500) -> HUD callout line + specs -> slow camera tracking through 3D wireframe.

chapters.title: 5-Mile VLF Trailing Wire, Submarine Links & EMP Hardening
chapters.editing_formula: Aircraft gentle banking turn diagram -> 5-mile trailing wire deployment -> VLF radio wave penetration into ocean seawater to reach nuclear ballistic subs -> analog wire-mesh windows.

chapters.title: Command Network Redundancy & Closing Verdict
chapters.editing_formula: Air Force E-4B (4 units) + Navy E-6 Mercury (16 units) distributed grid -> B-2 Spirit link -> sponsor transition.

cinematography_rules: Continuous subtle camera push-in or gentle orbital rotation (no static camera for > 2 seconds)
X-Ray / Cutaway schematic view when explaining internal mechanics or components
Callout cards tethered to specific coordinates with glowing anchor dots
Laser beam connection lines for signal paths (satellite uplink / undersea submarine links)
Audio-visual sync: Sound whoosh and sub-bass drop on compartment transitions
